description: Moosewave custom WAF rules layered on top of the managed OWASP CRS.

rules.description: Aggressive bot mitigation on public form submissions.

Block public form submissions with no Origin/Referer (curl spam). The Origin half must test ABSENCE, not emptiness: http.request.headers["origin"] is a Map of arrays, a missing key yields an EMPTY array, and indexing [0] into it produces a missing value — which compares false against everything, including "". So the previous `headers["origin"][0] eq ""` matched only a request that sent a literal `Origin:` with an empty value, and never matched the curl traffic this rule names, because curl sends no Origin header at all. The rule read as protection and blocked nothing. `not any(...[*] != "")` is the documented idiom and is true in both cases: header absent, or present and empty.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/public/forms/[^/]+/submit$") and (http.referer eq "") and not any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] != "")

rules.description: Block traffic from CU, IR, KP, SY (OFAC comprehensive country sanctions) plus RU (a Moosewave business decision, NOT an OFAC comprehensive embargo — Russia is subject to extensive sectoral and targeted measures, not a country-wide one). The previous description attributed the whole list to Treasury OFAC, which overstated the legal basis for the RU entry and made a discretionary availability decision look mandatory: anyone reviewing this would have concluded it could not be changed. Note also that OFAC's comprehensive programs cover the Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk REGIONS of Ukraine, which a country-code match cannot express — so this rule is not, and cannot be, a complete sanctions control on its own.
Block known-bad JA3 fingerprints (curl-impersonator, common scraper kits).
Challenge >5 POSTs/min to /api/v1/auth/login from one IP.

Only accept POSTs to /api/public/stripe/webhook from Stripe's published IPs (https://stripe.com/files/ips/ips_webhooks.txt). The list is maintained out-of-band; this rule must be regenerated weekly via `infra/cloudflare/refresh-stripe-ips.sh`.
